content.text:
I wrote the game to `index.html` in the working folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so it's checked by reading the code, not by running it.

It has a 4x4 board of HTML elements with tiles that move with the arrow keys and merge matching neighbours. Each move adds a 2 or 4 (90% / 10%), the score goes up by the merged values, and the page shows the score plus a stored best score. "New Game" restarts, and a "Game over" overlay appears when no moves are left.

While re-reading the code I fixed two bugs in the merge logic. One removed the surviving tile's element, so merged tiles would vanish. The other let old merge markers trigger extra animations. Neither fix has been tested in a browser.
